currentCard.explanation: Это Грейт-Смоки-Маунтинс: NPS связывает название с дымкой, которую видят над горами. Летучие вещества леса образуют частицы, рассеивающие короткие синие волны света.

sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.individualGround: NPS article and FAQ directly connect GreatSmokyMountains name to blue/bluish-gray forest haze and Cherokee land-of-blue-smoke naming. All four options are real US national parks; none is rejected for being imaginary. Acadia can have pollution haze, but a haze occurrence is not the tested name-origin relation. Positive official etymology uniquely supports key1 among these labels.

sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.literal: Это Грейт-Смоки-Маунтинс: NPS связывает название с дымкой, которую видят над горами. Летучие вещества леса образуют частицы, рассеивающие короткие синие волны света.
sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.individualGround: Directly names GreatSmokyMountains in first sentence, then adds source-backed mechanism: forestVOCs react with sunlight/moisture to form fine particles scattering especially shortblue wavelengths. Russian causal summary need not enumerate every intermediate condition; it does not call the haze fire smoke or uniquely anthropogenic pollution. Two natural sentences.

absoluteLevel.basis: Independent absolute audience inference: a large Russian-speaking adult quiz audience familiar with ordinary school English can recognize smoke/smoky (дым/дымный) through Смоки and connect it in one step with the explicit blue-haze clue; mountains is also an ordinary transparent name component. This does not require memorizing an obscure US trail or detailed park history. Cyrillic transliteration weakens the cue versus English spelling, and monolingual readers may find it harder; the judgment is for a large general English-familiar cohort, not a claim every adult knows the park. It is an editorial difficulty judgment, not a population survey or a conclusion from source presence, visitorcount, frozenlevel or comparison with harder park cards. No blanket US-proper-name/English/numeric-note ban applied.
